name: Aurora Wireless Headphones
description: Immersive 40mm drivers with active noise cancellation and 36 hours of battery life. Plush memory-foam ear cushions keep long listening sessions comfortable, while the low-latency mode is tuned for gaming and video.

name: Nimbus Mechanical Keyboard
description: A compact 75% mechanical keyboard with gasket-mounted switches, double-shot PBT keycaps, and per-key RGB. Fully hot-swappable so you can tune the feel to exactly how you like it.

name: Solaris Desk Lamp
description: An adjustable LED desk lamp with a wide color-temperature range and stepless dimming. The weighted base and aluminum arm hold any angle, and the built-in USB port keeps your phone topped up.

name: Drift Insulated Bottle
description: Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold for a full day. Made from 18/8 stainless steel with a leak-proof lid and a powder finish that resists scratches.

name: Pulse Smartwatch
description: Track heart rate, sleep, and 40+ workout modes with a bright always-on AMOLED display. Water resistant to 50m with a 10-day battery so you can leave the charger at home.

name: Canvas Everyday Backpack
description: A water-resistant everyday backpack with a padded 16" laptop sleeve, hidden anti-theft pocket, and a luggage pass-through. Ergonomic straps distribute weight so it stays comfortable on long days.

name: Echo Portable Speaker
description: A rugged portable speaker with 360° sound, deep bass, and IP67 waterproofing. Pair two together for true stereo, and enjoy up to 20 hours of playtime on a single charge.

name: Terra Self-Watering Planter
description: A self-watering planter with a visible water-level indicator and a reservoir that keeps roots hydrated for up to two weeks. Minimalist matte finish that fits any shelf or windowsill.
